name: Xián Zhě: Líng Huī Zhī Yàn
source:
Step into the role of Nolan, a commoner mage, as you follow your mentor to Sabelien, the royal capital of the kingdom of Aorleton. Here, you’ll forge bonds with a vivid cast of characters and get tangled in a shadowy power struggle. Will you choose to stay away from the chaos, or embrace it and carve your own path? Every choice you make will shape the fates of the Kingdom of Aorleton and the Mage Guild...

— This is a dreamlike journey, an epic of sages that never fades.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3940100/_The_Sages_Spirit_Shining_Flame/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
扮演诺兰，一名平民法师，跟随导师前往奥尔顿王国的王都萨贝利恩。在这里，你将与生动的角色建立联系，并卷入一场阴暗的权力斗争。你会选择远离混乱，还是拥抱它并开辟自己的道路？你所做的每一个选择都将决定奥尔顿王国和法师公会的命运……

——这是一场如梦般的旅程，一部永不褪色的圣人史诗。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3940100/_The_Sages_Spirit_Shining_Flame/]Steam[/url]]
